# Argo Books

> Argo Books is accounting software for small businesses, for Windows, macOS and Linux. Its API lets other apps send revenue, expenses, customers, suppliers, products, categories and refunds into a business's books, with the owner's permission.

## API

- [Add Argo Books to a project](https://argorobots.com/documentation/agents.md): step-by-step setup for an AI coding agent
- [API overview](https://argorobots.com/documentation/pages/api/overview.php): how the API works and its conventions
- [Resources](https://argorobots.com/documentation/pages/api/resources.php): every object and field
- [Errors](https://argorobots.com/documentation/pages/api/errors.php): every error code
